articles.headline: Tottenham defender Cristian Romero out for remainder of the season - sources
articles.description: Tottenham defender Cristian Romero will be out for the remainder of the season after suffering a knee injury in the 1-0 defeat to Sunderland, ESPN Argentina reports.
